chunks: Al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام was asked about the reason for the palm branch, so he said:
Indeed, the punishment is averted from him as long as it remains fresh.

key_terms.الْجَرِيدَةِ: the palm branch placed with the deceased
key_terms.الْعَذَابُ: punishment or chastisement affecting the deceased
key_terms.عِلَّةِ: the reason or cause behind a practice

ai.seo_question: Why is a fresh palm branch placed with the deceased in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the fresh palm branch placed with the deceased has the effect of warding off punishment for as long as it remains moist. It indicates a funerary practice connected to conditions of the deceased after death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.401 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the reason for placing the palm branch (jareedah),
Imam (as) replied: "
Indeed, the punishment is averted from them (the deceased) as long as it remains fresh."
